limitations: Run this mode separately after all other browser tasks end; this script cannot detect unrelated browser workloads.
Headless Edge desktop/mobile viewport simulation with browser-protocol wheel input, not physical touch or a real phone.
rAF intervals are browser scheduling observations, not GPU render durations, hardware FPS or real INP.
The measurement rAF and DOM metric sampling add instrumentation overhead and run even when the presentation controller is idle.
drawCount is the scene root Canvas counter, not every photograph/CSS paint or WebGL output.
No screenshot, screencast or encoding is performed in this mode. All samples and long tasks are retained.
Mobile mode reads static HTML and does not imply a mobile sequence or real phone performance test.
